text:
laura: 2pm micro-challenge idea: single-leg hop test + quick barefoot toe-strength drills on the patio. Loser brings smoothie ingredients tomorrow? :man-running: :banana:

ignacio: Oof. My left ankle is still grumpy but I can do the toe drills. Can someone demo the hop form?

ben: demo = hop forward 3x single-leg, measure distance with a shoe. I've got the tape measure. :straight_ruler:

zoe: I'll time and record hops for posterity. also, can we add a 1-min wall-sit for the true suffering bracket? :joy:

laura: love it. order: warmup -> 3x single-leg hops each side -> 60s wall-sit -> 2min barefoot toe picks. Keep it short and safe.

cardio-bot: Reminder: warmup at 13:55, challenge starts 14:00. Estimated session length 12 minutes.

ignacio: small safety note: please bring knees stable and do step-downs if anything twinges.

ben: Logistics: tape measure and chalk at the patio bench. Leave laptops at desk.

zoe: snack-bot can we arrange smoothies? what are options? :smoothie:

snack-bot: Options available: banana-blueberry (dairy-free), peanut-butter-buzz (contains nuts), greens + apple (vegan). Labelled boxes on bench after session.

laura: peanut-butter-buzz is tempting but nut-free option pls for Sam (allergy). winner picks 2 people to grab ingredients.

ignacio: proposal: loser makes smoothies tomorrow morning. if multiple losers, split ingredients duty. fair? :thinking:

ben: fine by me. also small prize: winner gets to choose the post-run playlist for Friday.

zoe: stakes = high. playlist power confirmed. :musical_note:

laura: quick poll: react :one: if you join full challenge, :two: for toe-strength only, :three: skip but cheer. I'll close at 13:50.

ignacio: :two:

ben: :one:

zoe: :one:

laura: Nice turnout. Reminder: shoes off for toe drills, mats on patio, keep it quiet for the call in flex-room. Pics ok but tag people before posting.

cardio-bot: Reminder posted in #random at 13:55.

ben: Also bringing a tiny ankle brace for anyone who wants extra support. see you at the patio! :wave:
